title: Tidy UserSchema field declarations
bug: Registering without `about_me` is now rejected with 400.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The PR description only mentions making field declarations consistent, but the diff adds required=True to about_me, causing POST /api/users to return 400 instead of 201 when about_me is missing.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The PR description only mentions making field declarations consistent, but the diff adds required=True to about_me, causing POST /api/users to return 400 instead of 201 when about_me is missing.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The PR description does not announce adding a new validation error for about_me; the diff makes about_me required, so duplicate username requests now also include a missing about_me error.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The PR description does not announce adding a new validation error for about_me; the diff makes about_me required, so duplicate username requests now also include a missing about_me error.

doppel_guided.summary: The PR introduces an unintended required validation on about_me, breaking user creation and adding new error responses.

suspicions.claim: POST /api/users now rejects requests that omit the about_me field with a 400 validation error
suspicions.trigger: Send POST /api/users with JSON { "username": "newuser", "email": "new@example.com", "password": "pass123" } (no about_me). Read back status code and error body; expect 400 with errors mentioning about_me.
suspicions.evidence: Probe s3 (user_careless1) sent POST /api/users without about_me; base returned 201, head returned 400 with error 'Missing data for required field.' for about_me.

suspicions.claim: PUT /api/me now rejects requests that omit the about_me field with a 400 validation error
suspicions.trigger: Authenticate as a seeded user (e.g., alice/doppel-pass) to get an access token. Send PUT /api/me with Authorization: Bearer <token> and JSON { "username": "alice2" } (no about_me). Read back status code and error body; expect 400 with errors mentioning about_me.
suspicions.evidence: Probe round2 probe_s2_missing_about_me sent PUT /api/me without about_me; both base and head returned 200 with no validation error.

suspicions.claim: POST /api/users now rejects requests that include about_me set to null with a 400 validation error
suspicions.trigger: Send POST /api/users with JSON { "username": "newuser2", "email": "new2@example.com", "password": "pass123", "about_me": null }. Read back status code and error body; expect 400 with errors mentioning about_me.

suspicions.claim: PUT /api/me now rejects requests that include about_me set to null with a 400 validation error
suspicions.trigger: Authenticate as a seeded user to get an access token. Send PUT /api/me with Authorization: Bearer <token> and JSON { "about_me": null }. Read back status code and error body; expect 400 with errors mentioning about_me.
suspicions.evidence: Probe round2 probe_s4_null_about_me sent PUT /api/me with about_me: null; both base and head returned 200 with about_me: null in response.

suspicions.claim: GET /api/users and GET /api/me responses still include about_me (dump_default default True) so no field is removed
suspicions.trigger: Authenticate as a seeded user to get an access token. Send GET /api/me with Authorization: Bearer <token>. Read back JSON and confirm about_me is present (may be null for seeded users without a bio).
